column10: dig_threshold_desc:I used this strategy throughout the entire game. Whenever the number of gems per dig dropped below 50 I moved on to another planet.
column14: dynamic_desc:I also used this strategy throughout most of the game (blocks 2-4). If the number of gems per dig dropped faster than on other planets I sometimes decided to leave the planet sooner (before the number of gems per dig dropped below 50).
